# Money Format

## Summary
`formatMoney(amount, code)` renders an `AmountWithCurrency` value for display: `Intl.NumberFormat` in the currency style when the ISO 4217 code is known, a plain number with up to two decimals when it is missing or unrecognised, and an empty string for an absent amount so a template never prints `NaN` or `undefined`.

## Usage
```ts
import { formatMoney } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/crm/utils';

formatMoney(this.args.model.value?.amount, this.args.model.value?.currency?.code);
```
Used by Opportunity (deal value) and Campaign (budget, spend). The value itself is always stored as the base `AmountWithCurrency` field; this helper only formats it.

## Non-goals
Arithmetic over line items and balances belongs with the Commerce cards, not here. Locale is fixed to `en-US` until a consumer needs otherwise.
